This is Margaret. For thirty-one years, she's been the first face you see at Hartley and Co.
She knows everyone's birthday. Remembers how you take your tea. And next Friday… she retires.
Priya wants to do something special. But half the team works from home. Some left years ago. And the envelope? It never makes it past the second floor.
So she starts a Collection Pot. One link — dropped in the team chat, emailed to old colleagues, even taped up at reception as a QR code.
Then the messages start pouring in. From the Leeds office. From kitchen tables. From people she hadn't seen in a decade.
You made my first day less scary.
You never forgot my kids' names.
The office won't be the same without you.
On Friday, Margaret opens her Pot. The gift was lovely. But it was the messages she read twice.
Collection Pot. Collect together, celebrate together.
